references.text: The Lord gives wisdom to the righteous, but keeps it hidden from others, similar to how the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven are given to some and not to others.
The psalm speaks of telling God's deeds in parables, parallel to how Jesus communicates the mysteries of the kingdom through parables.
Jesus explains why he uses parables, which is to reveal truths to his disciples while keeping them hidden from others, paralleling Matthew 13:11.
Paul speaks about the mystery that has been revealed, reflecting the idea that certain truths are given to specific people, just as in Matthew 13:11.
